claims.object_text: Q/R editing at nearly 100% efficiency in nervous system
claims.quote: edits the GRIA2 transcript Q/R editing site with almost 100% efficiency in the nervous system.

claims.object_text: Edited GRIA2 R encodes GLUA2 R subunit essential to prevent seizures by limiting AMPA receptor cation permeability
claims.quote: The edited GRIA2 R transcript encodes the GLUA2 R subunit isoform of tetrameric α-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazolepropionic acid (AMPA) receptors, which is essential to prevent seizures associated with aberrantly elevated AMPA receptor cation permeability.

claims.object_text: Reduced Q/R editing increases AMPA receptor permeability via upregulation of GLUA2 Q and reduced GLUA2 levels, yielding GLUA2-lacking, calcium-permeable AMPA receptors
claims.quote: Reduced GRIA2 Q/R site editing increases AMPA receptor permeability by upregulating the expression of the GLUA2 Q isoform and reducing overall GLUA2 subunit levels, resulting in AMPA receptors that lack GLUA2 and are calcium-permeable.

claims.object_text: Failure to edit Q/R site leads to failure of intron 11 splicing
claims.quote: failure to edit the GRIA2 Q/R site leads to failure of intron 11 splicing
